tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to tear away, dissipate
1a) (Niphal) to be dispersed, be dissipated

1) to salt, season
1a) (Qal) to salt, season
1b) (Pual) to be salted
1c) (Hophal) to be rubbed or washed with salt
Aramaic equivalent: me.lach (מְלַח "to eat salt" H4415)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to rub to pieces or pulverize; intransitively, to disappear as dust; to salt whether internally (to season with salt) or externally (to rub with salt)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also as denominative from H4417 (מֶלַח)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] at all, salt, season, temper together, vanish away.
